reply.english: I don't know, but it's cloudy.

dialogue.speaker: Zainab
dialogue.arabic: صباح الخير علي، شلون الجو اليوم؟
dialogue.transliteration: Saba7 ilkheer 3ali, shloon ijjaw iyyoom?
dialogue.english: Good morning Ali, what's the weather like today?

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.arabic: صباح النور. الجو مغيّم شوية، بس مو بارد
dialogue.transliteration: Saba7 innoor. ijjaw mghayyim shwayya, bas mu baarid
dialogue.english: Good morning. It's a bit cloudy, but not cold.

dialogue.speaker: Zainab
dialogue.arabic: يعني شتگول، راح تمطر؟
dialogue.transliteration: ya3ni shtgool, raa7 timTur?
dialogue.english: So what do you think, will it rain?

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.arabic: ما أدري، بس اكو هوا هواية من الصبح
dialogue.transliteration: ma adri, bas aku hawa hawaaya min iSSubu7
dialogue.english: I don't know, but there's been a lot of wind since morning.

dialogue.speaker: Zainab
dialogue.arabic: أنا أحس الدنيا أحر من البارحة
dialogue.transliteration: ana a7iss iddinya a7arr min ilbaari7a
dialogue.english: I feel like it's hotter out than yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.arabic: لا، أنا أحس العكس، صارت أبرد شوية
dialogue.transliteration: laa, ana a7iss il3aks, Saarat abrad shwayya
dialogue.english: No, I feel the opposite, it's gotten a bit colder.

dialogue.speaker: Zainab
dialogue.arabic: المهم، شفت الشمس طالعة؟
dialogue.transliteration: ilmuhimm, shift ishshams Taal3a?
dialogue.english: Anyway, did you see the sun's out?

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.arabic: إي، بس مغطيها الغيم شوية
dialogue.transliteration: ee, bas mghaTTeeha ilgheem shwayya
dialogue.english: Yes, but the clouds cover it a bit.

dialogue.speaker: Zainab
dialogue.arabic: خذ شمسية وياك على كل حال
dialogue.transliteration: khudh shamsiyya wiyyaak 3ala kull 7aal
dialogue.english: Take an umbrella with you just in case.

dialogue.speaker: Ali
dialogue.arabic: زين، زين إنچ ذكرتيني
dialogue.transliteration: zeen, zeen innich dhakkarteeni
dialogue.english: Ok, good that you reminded me.

dialogue.speaker: Zainab
dialogue.arabic: الله يعافيك، أشوفك بعدين
dialogue.transliteration: allah y3aafeek, ashoofak ba3deen
dialogue.english: Take care, see you later.

response.english: Yes, bring something heavy with you.

response.transliteration: ee, aku hawa hawaaya min iSSubu7
response.english: Yes, a lot of wind since morning.

dialogue.speaker: Rasha
dialogue.arabic: عمر، شنو أحلى فصل عندك؟
dialogue.transliteration: 3umar, shinu a7la faSl 3indak?
dialogue.english: Omar, what's your favorite season?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: أنا أحب الربيع، الجو يصير لطيف والدنيا خضرة
dialogue.transliteration: ana a7ibb irrabee3, ijjaw yiSeer laTeef w iddinya khaDra
dialogue.english: I love spring, the weather gets pleasant and everything is green.

dialogue.speaker: Rasha
dialogue.arabic: أنا لا، أحب الشتا
dialogue.transliteration: ana laa, a7ibb ishshita
dialogue.english: Not me, I love winter.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: صدگ؟ وما تبردين هواية؟
dialogue.transliteration: Sidig? w ma tibirdeen hawaaya?
dialogue.english: Really? Don't you get very cold?

dialogue.speaker: Rasha
dialogue.arabic: لا، أحب ألبس شي ثگيل وأشرب چاي بالبيت
dialogue.transliteration: laa, a7ibb albas shi thagiil w ashrab chaay bilbeet
dialogue.english: No, I like wearing something heavy and drinking tea at home.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: بس الصيف ببغداد طويل وحار، مو؟
dialogue.transliteration: bas iSSeef bibaghdaad Taweel w 7aarr, mu?
dialogue.english: But summer in Baghdad is long and hot, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: Rasha
dialogue.arabic: إي، وما أگدر أطلع من البيت من الحر
dialogue.transliteration: ee, w ma agdar aTla3 min ilbeet min il7arr
dialogue.english: Yes, and I can't leave the house because of the heat.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: وهسّه احنا بأي فصل؟ الجو يتغيّر كل يوم
dialogue.transliteration: w hassa i7na bi2ay faSl? ijjaw yitghayyar kull yoom
dialogue.english: And what season are we in now? The weather changes every day.

dialogue.speaker: Rasha
dialogue.arabic: بالخريف، وورگ الشجر بدا يوگع
dialogue.transliteration: bilkhareef, w warag ishshajar bida yooga3
dialogue.english: In fall, and the leaves have started to fall.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: الجو يتغيّر هواية بين الفصول عدنا
dialogue.transliteration: ijjaw yitghayyar hawaaya been ilfuSool 3idna
dialogue.english: The weather changes a lot between the seasons here.

dialogue.speaker: Rasha
dialogue.arabic: صح، بس كل فصل إله حلاوته
dialogue.transliteration: Sa7, bas kull faSl ilah 7alaawta

dialogue.english: Good, wear sports shoes.

dialogue.arabic: وإذا مطرت؟
dialogue.transliteration: w iza maTrat?

dialogue.arabic: خذي شمسية وياچ، مو مثل المرة الماضية
dialogue.transliteration: khudhi shamsiyya wiyyaach, mu mithl ilmarra ilmaaDya
dialogue.english: Take an umbrella with you, not like last time.

dialogue.transliteration: aah, ilmarra ilmaaDya niseet ilbaaTo maal ilmaTar bilbeet
dialogue.english: Ah, last time I forgot the raincoat at home.

dialogue.english: And you got very cold, I remember.

dialogue.transliteration: ee, halmarra raa7 aakhudh jaakit w sweetar ba3ad
dialogue.english: Yes, this time I'll take a jacket and a sweater too.

dialogue.transliteration: w khudhi ilgubba3a, ishshams gawiyya biZZuhur

reply.english: Yes, it's going to rain tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.arabic: أحمد، شفت النشرة الجوية؟
dialogue.transliteration: a7mad, shift innashra ijjawiyya?
dialogue.english: Ahmed, did you see the weather forecast?

dialogue.speaker: Ahmed
dialogue.arabic: إي، باچر راح تمطر من الصبح
dialogue.transliteration: ee, baachir raa7 timTur min iSSubu7
dialogue.english: Yes, tomorrow it's going to rain from the morning.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.arabic: يعني السفرة للجبل ما راح تصير؟
dialogue.transliteration: ya3ni issafra lijjabal ma raa7 tSeer?
dialogue.english: So the trip to the mountain won't happen?

dialogue.speaker: Ahmed
dialogue.arabic: تعتمد على الجو، إذا تمطر هواية راح نأجلها
dialogue.transliteration: ta3timid 3ala ijjaw, iza timTur hawaaya raa7 n2ajjilha
dialogue.english: It depends on the weather, if it rains a lot we'll postpone it.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.arabic: واليوم الجو حلو، يلا نطلع نتمشى
dialogue.transliteration: w iyyoom ijjaw 7ilu, yalla niTla3 nitmasha
dialogue.english: And today the weather's nice, let's go out for a walk.

dialogue.speaker: Ahmed
dialogue.arabic: ما أگدر أطلع هسّه، الجو حار هواية
dialogue.transliteration: ma agdar aTla3 hassa, ijjaw 7aarr hawaaya
dialogue.english: I can't go out now, it's too hot.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.arabic: زين، الليلة نگعد بالبلكونة، الجو يصير لطيف بالليل
dialogue.transliteration: zeen, illeela nig3id bilbalkoona, ijjaw yiSeer laTeef billeel
dialogue.english: Ok, tonight we'll sit on the balcony, the weather gets pleasant at night.

dialogue.speaker: Ahmed
dialogue.arabic: فكرة حلوة، وشلون السهرة مال باچر؟
dialogue.transliteration: fikra 7ilwa, w shloon issahra maal baachir?
dialogue.english: Nice idea, and what about tomorrow's gathering?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.arabic: لأن راح تمطر، خل نأجلها
dialogue.transliteration: li2an raa7 timTur, khal n2ajjilha
dialogue.english: Since it's going to rain, let's postpone it.

dialogue.speaker: Ahmed
dialogue.arabic: زين، وطول ما الجو حلو راح نضل نطلع
dialogue.transliteration: zeen, w Tool ma ijjaw 7ilu raa7 niDall niTla3
dialogue.english: Ok, and as long as the weather's nice we'll keep going out.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.arabic: إن شاء الله، أشوفك الليلة
dialogue.transliteration: in shaa2 allah, ashoofak illeela
dialogue.english: God willing, see you tonight.

challenge.title: Plan Your Day Around the Weather
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Iraqi conversation, at least 10 lines, between two friends deciding what to do today based on the weather. It must include asking about the weather, describing the weather with at least two different weather words, a mention of the season, advice on what to wear, and a decision on whether to go out or stay home.
required_elements: A question asking what the weather is like, using شلون الجو.
At least two different weather descriptions, such as حار, بارد, مغيّم, or دا تمطر.
A mention of the season, using a word like الصيف, الشتا, الربيع, or الخريف.
Advice on what to wear, using لازم تلبس or البس.
A plan that depends on the weather, using إذا الجو حلو or إذا الجو مو زين.
A reminder to take an umbrella, using خذ شمسية وياك or لازم تاخذ شمسية.
A final decision to go out (نطلع) or stay home (نگعد بالبيت).

dialogue.speaker: Zahra
dialogue.arabic: صباح الخير، شلون الجو اليوم؟
dialogue.transliteration: Saba7 ilkheer, shloon ijjaw iyyoom?
dialogue.english: Good morning, what's the weather like today?

dialogue.arabic: صباح النور، الجو مغيّم شوية بس مو بارد هواية

dialogue.speaker: Zahra
